date_note: The article says the attack was on Tuesday morning; resolved against its 20 November date to 17 November.
exec: A German municipality's administration was disrupted by a cyberattack and was fully operational again about 57 hours later, per the town hall.
plain: The municipality of Neuried in Germany was hit by a cyberattack on a Tuesday. Its IT systems were running again on Thursday afternoon, about 57 hours later.
summary: Schwarzwälder Bote reports, citing a town hall statement, that the municipality of Neuried was back online after a cyberattack on Tuesday morning. Its IT systems were running again on Thursday at about 16:15, about 57 hours after the attack, and the administration was fully operational. Mayor Tobias Uhrich thanked IT staff, an IT service provider and the police.
title: Neuried municipality back online about 57 hours after cyberattack, town hall says

validation.note: Single publisher (Schwarzwälder Bote) relaying the town hall's own statement.

review.note: Compared title, summary, date (Tuesday 17 Nov from 20 Nov article), Thursday 16:15 restoration, 57 hours, town hall statement, mayor thanks against the Schwarzwälder Bote article; no stronger wording, single_source correct
